description: Returns the CookiePal banner script tag to paste into a site, for one domain in the connected account. It is byte-for-byte the tag the CookiePal dashboard copies for that domain, including `defer` for a Shopify store. Paste it as given: the URL it loads is specific to the domain, and a tag built by hand or copied from another site will not verify. Use verify_installation afterwards to confirm it is live.

domainId.description: Which domain’s tag to return, such as example.com. Omit it for the account’s default domain, the one the dashboard opens on.

name: get_install_snippet

defer.description: Whether the tag carries `defer`, which it does for a Shopify store.

scriptUrl.description: The banner script this domain’s tag loads.

snippet.description: The exact tag to paste, identical to the one the dashboard copies.

title: Get the CookiePal banner install tag
